title_sq: Tek Bulevardi I Ri, Shitet Dyqan Dupleks, Mundesi Ideale Investimi!
description_sq: Tek Bulevardi I Ri, Shitet Dyqan Dupleks, Mundesi Ideale Investimi!!! Ambienti ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje pallati 7 katesh, me siperfaqe 53 m2. Lartesia e katit eshte 5 meter dhe kjo i ka dhene mundesine te jete ne 2 kate ne formen Dupleks. Eshte i ndare ne nje ambient dhe tualet ne secilin kat. Kati 2 ka hyrje te veten dhe kjo jep mundesine e zhvillimit te 2 bizneseve njekohesisht. Eshte ideal per zhvillimin e tipologjive te ndryshme si: zyre avokatie, zyre noterie, zyre kontabiliteti, klinike dentare, klinike estetike, etj. Prona ndodhet ne nje zone e cila vitet e fundit eshte duke marre zhvillim shume te madh .
title_en: At New Boulevard, Duplex Store for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!
description_en: At New Boulevard, Duplex Shop for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!!! The environment is located on the 0th floor of a 7-story building, with an area of ​​53 m2. The height of the floor is 5 meters and this has given it the opportunity to be on 2 floors in the duplex form. It is divided into a room and a toilet on each floor. The 2nd floor has its own entrance and this gives the possibility of developing 2 businesses simultaneously. It is ideal for the development of different typologies such as: law office, notary office, accounting office, dental clinic, aesthetic clinic, etc. The property is located in an area which has been undergoing great development in recent years.
